## Context

Brief description of what should change and why.

## Goal

What problem does this feature solve?

## Cases to consider

Edge cases, constraints or interactions with existing features.

## Acceptance criteria

What must be true for the issue to be considered done.

## Expected result

What the user should get once the issue is resolved.

## Additional information

Any other data or references that help to understand or implement the request.
